title: Earlier references in the constructed gate list
statement: For a natural number $n$, let $G_k$ be the gate list defined by $G_0=[1]$ and by appending, at each step from $k$ to $k+1$, the gates $	ext{varOrOne}(k)$, addition of gates $0$ and $3k+1$, and multiplication of gates $3k$ and $3k+2$. For every pair of natural numbers $k,i$ with $i<|G_k|$, the gate at position $i$ is either an input variable or the constant $1$, or is an addition, subtraction, or multiplication gate whose two referenced positions are both strictly less than $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is strictly less than the length of $G_k$
